rca of the issue: Review-on-failed bug RCA: Frontend handler invokes KE.documentReviewContext(setId, docId) → GET /api/knowledge/catalog-sets/{id}/documents/{docId}/review-context. The Promise rejects, frontend catches and shows generic 'Impossibile aprire il review context'. Likely causes (in priority order): (1) backend route restricts to extraction_status IN ('review','validated') excluding 'failed'; (2) review-context builder dereferences a None field (pages_processed, last_error_at) that is NULL for failed docs; (3) tenant/RBAC scoping mismatch when doc.status='failed'. Fix: in /app/backend/routers/extraction_jobs.py (or wherever review-context endpoint lives), allow status='failed' and return {count: 0, first_anomaly: null} when no anomalies are computable. Also surface real error message in frontend handler via err.response.data.detail for faster future debugging.
